(memantine) Adverse Effects and Precautions Common adverse effects with memantine include con- stipation, dizziness, headache, hypertension, and som- nolence. Less common reactions such as anxiety, hallucinations, confusion, fatigue, abnormal gait, hypertonia, vomiting, fungal infections, cystitis, thromboembolism, and increased libido have also oc- curred.
